originality.rationale: The named inspected full primary articles establish the invariant and broad estimates, but no exact two-parameter rook-graph evaluation. Even the quoted 2024 general degree lower bound is strictly weaker on balanced boards (12 versus 15 on 5-by-5). Published-record searches under rook, Cartesian, line-graph and [3]-Roman names returned adjacent but mathematically inapplicable parameters. Potential unindexed coverage and an inaccessible 2023 full text remain residual risks, not evidence of a covering theorem.
residual_risks: Full primary article of Khalili et al. (2023) was inaccessible after lawful open-access and preprint attempts; only its abstract and bibliographic material were available. It could in principle contain an unsuspected general theorem.
Unindexed publications or alternate terminology might contain the same theorem; failure of targeted searches is not a mathematical novelty proof.
Earliest bibliographically verified publication date 2021-02-01 may differ from a still earlier online-first public appearance; no earlier exact public day was substantiated.

value.rationale: Exact evaluation of an established defensive graph invariant on an infinite canonical two-parameter family is mathematically motivated. The proof identifies a width threshold n=2m with two distinct optimal allocation patterns and closes an actual gap left by generic degree bounds (for instance square 5-by-5). This is an explanatory classification of the minimum across the whole family, not mere renaming or isolated arithmetic.
